title: Probing Proton Structure via Physics-Guided Neural Networks in Holographic QCD
summary: Describing the proton structure function $F_2(x,Q^2)$ across the nonperturbative and transition regimes of QCD remains a major theoretical challenge. We construct a physics-guided phenomenological representation combining fermion-resonance and Pomeron-like AdS/QCD basis functions with a neural parametrization. The resonance sector is constrained by the AdS eigenvalue problem and physical proton mass, while the neural component describes effective kinematic mixing, Pomeron normalization, and a regularized log-space correction.
